title: The Launch Pad
description:
-We've always held ourselves to a high standard in providing a safe and clean environment for our guests. Due to coronavirus we are taking extra steps and using approved sanitizers on all frequently touched surfaces, using approved cleaners and providing hand soap and plenty of linens. As of mid-June we will both be fully vaccinated, but still following distancing and masking recommendations.

The space
Sandy is a vintage and antique dealer and does her own refinishing.  John has been a carpenter 40 years and loves modern design.  Together, they designed, built, and hand picked or custom fit the Launch Pad with your comfort and enjoyment in mind.  It’s hip, private, and modern.

Guest access
The completely separate apartment and private garden are all yours for the duration of your stay. There is private parking for two-three vehicles.

Other things to note
-We are easily accessible from I40, I65 and I24 and cross country travelers are welcome. The fenced yard is perfect for dog travelers who might need to stretch their legs as well.
-Two queen sized beds
